findings.issue: No optimistic locking on ANY PATCH handler - all 9 use last-write-wins. No version column, If-Match header, or ETag comparison anywhere.
findings.impact: Two users simultaneously editing the same message, workspace, channel, or webhook will silently overwrite each other's changes. Data loss on concurrent edits guaranteed.
findings.fix: Add version column to all mutable entities, require If-Match header on PATCH, return 409 Conflict on version mismatch

findings.issue: GDPR DELETE /account performs 8 sequential deletes without transaction wrapping - partial deletion if any step fails
findings.impact: If deletion fails mid-way (e.g. after removing messages but before removing the user), the user is left with dangling references and can't retry. Data integrity violation.
findings.fix: Wrap all deletion operations in a Supabase RPC transaction with BEGIN/COMMIT/ROLLBACK

findings.issue: webhook_endpoints.created_by FK references auth.users(id) with NO ON DELETE clause - defaults to NO ACTION
findings.impact: Deleting an auth user who created webhook endpoints will fail with foreign key violation. Orphan blocking delete.
findings.fix: Add ON DELETE SET NULL or ON DELETE CASCADE to the webhook_endpoints.created_by FK

findings.issue: API services use hard DELETE instead of calling soft-delete functions that exist in migrations (soft_delete_workspace, soft_delete_channel, etc.)
findings.impact: Deleted workspaces, channels, and messages are permanently lost with no recovery option. Soft-delete infrastructure exists but is bypassed.
findings.fix: Replace .delete() calls with .update({ deleted_at: new Date().toISOString() }) or RPC calls to soft-delete functions

findings.issue: No transaction coverage on multi-table writes - message creation, webhook delivery, notification creation are fire-and-forget with no rollback safety
findings.impact: Message inserted but webhook trigger or mention notification may fail silently. No atomicity guarantee for any write operation spanning multiple tables.
findings.fix: Use Supabase RPC functions with BEGIN/COMMIT/ROLLBACK for multi-table write operations

findings.issue: All 6 data retention/purge/archive pg_cron.schedule calls are commented out. Worker cleanup processor is a no-op with TODO comments.
findings.impact: Audit logs, notifications, consent logs, old messages, and webhook deliveries accumulate indefinitely. Unbounded table growth degrades query performance over time.
findings.fix: Enable pg_cron extension and uncomment cron.schedule calls. Implement cleanup logic in worker/src/processors/cleanup.ts

findings.issue: notification_preferences table is created with trigger-based defaults but has no API endpoints to read or write them
findings.impact: Data is written but never queried from the API. Preferences cannot be managed by users despite the settings UI having toggles for them.
findings.fix: Add API endpoints for notification preferences CRUD, or remove the table if superseded by user_preferences

findings.issue: 4 database tables are missing TypeScript types: thread_metadata, thread_participants, channel_role_overrides, notification_preferences
findings.impact: TypeScript code using these tables has implicit 'any' types. Runtime errors from type mismatches not caught at compile time. Drift between schema and types.
findings.fix: Add type definitions for all 4 missing tables to packages/db/src/types.ts
